% 08.07.2025 [Physical Hearing/Hybrid Hearing (as per request)] CRL.M.A. 19130/2025 (exemption from filing of complete chargesheet), CRL.M.A. 19131/2025 (exemption from filing of certified copies of FIR, settlement deed, aadhar cards and decree of divorce) & CRL.M.A.
19132/2025 (exemption from personal appearance of petitioner no.2 and petitioner no.3)
1. The petitioners have sought quashing of FIR No. 375/2022 of PS Aman Vihar for offence under Section 498A/406/34 IPC.
The petition has been filed on the ground that petitioners have compromised the dispute with the complainant de facto (respondent no. 2).
2. Learned counsel for petitioners submits that respondent no. 2, having entered into a settlement is trying to back out.
4. Subject to petitioner taking steps within one week, notice be issued to the respondent no. 2 returnable on 23.09.2025.
